newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE THURSDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE THURSDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steers or heifers confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.
Confirmed - 1,200 last week - none last year - 400
Wk to date - 68,300 last week - 98,200 last year - 106,800

Slaughter Steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 64.00; few Select and Choice 1350 lb Holsteins 57.00. Dressed Basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 102.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 64.00.

Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 68,300 head confirmed including 41,200 head or about 60 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
